brief:
A Palestinian official told Shehab Wire that Al-Aqsa Mosque represents a red line, warning that any tampering with Jerusalem's historical status would trigger serious repercussions. The statement came amid escalating tensions over the mosque and broader concerns about the city's future.

The official characterized recent developments at the site as explicit Zionist aggression against holy places and a deliberate attempt to impose a new reality by force. He attributed such actions to international silence and what he described as unjustifiable international failure to intervene.

title: Al-Aqsa a red line, Palestinian official warns of serious consequences
